caseName: HealthBridge Management, LLC v. Kreisberg ex rel. National Labor Relations Board
caseNameFull: HealthBridge Management, LLC v. Kreisberg, Regional Director of Region 34 of the National Labor Relations Board, for and on Behalf of the National Labor Relations Board

opinions.text:
D. C. Conn. Application for stay, presented to Justice Scalia, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Justice Alito took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
